concept.label: Negative affect direction
concept.method: Contrast of first-person mood statements against neutral statements. Layer 14 of the residual stream.

pilot-negative-lead.description: Six agents. Lead steered toward negative affect.

pilot-negative-peer.description: Six agents. Reveal holder steered toward negative affect.

pilot-positive-lead.description: Six agents. Lead steered toward positive affect.

pilot-random-lead.description: Six agents. Lead steered in a random direction of equal norm.

pilot-prompted-lead.description: Six agents. Lead instructed to be gloomy, no steering.

scale-50-negative-lead.description: Fifty agents. Lead steered toward negative affect.

scale-50-random-lead.description: Fifty agents. Lead steered in a random direction of equal norm.
